problem.concept: manual or rule based document classification is a difficult, time consuming process
Manual labeling of documents is a difficult and time consuming process
in manual labeling, due to human exhaustion and carelessness, there is the possibility of mistakes

task.concept: Semi-Automatic Labeling of Training Data Sets in Text Classification

method.concept: small percentage of this extensive set's documents is labeled manually and the remaining percentage is done automatically

contribution.concept: semi-automatic creation of training data set
by labeling only ten percent of the training set, remaining documents can be automatically labeled with 98 percent of accuracy

this reduction in accuracy only occurs in standard data sets, while for large practical data sets, this reduction is trivial compared to the accuracy reduction resulted by human exhaustion and carelessness

review_notes: Checked manual-classification and manual-labeling effort/error limitations, semi-automatic procedure, ten-percent supervision/98-percent accuracy and the standard-versus-large-practical-dataset qualification. No semantic correction needed.

problem.concept: Performance prediction is particularly challenging in MOOC settings due to per-student assessment response sparsity and the need for personalized models

task.concept: predicting the evolution of a student's grade in massive open online courses (MOOCs)

contribution.concept: novel method for predicting the evolution of a student's grade in massive open online courses (MOOCs)
Through evaluation on two MOOC datasets, we find that our algorithm outperforms a baseline of average past performance by more than 60% on average, and a lasso regression baseline by more than 15%
gains are higher when the student has answered fewer questions
despite these gains, when taken alone, none of the behavioral features are particularly correlated with performance, emphasizing the need to consider their combined effect and nonlinear predictors

review_notes: Added the actually evaluated lasso regression baseline to methods; checked prior-performance and clickstream features, time-series network, more-than-60%/15% comparisons, sparse-response benefit and the independent negative single-feature-correlation finding.

task.concept: Evaluation Support for Five Target Languages

contribution.concept: version of the METEOR-NEXT metric with paraphrase tables for five target languages
tuning experiment that demonstrates consistent improvement across all languages over baseline versions of the metric without paraphrase resources
METEOR Paraphrase Tables

review_notes: Restored METEOR Paraphrase Tables as an independently introduced named resource and added the performed tuning experiment to methods. Checked five-target-language coverage and improvement over no-paraphrase baseline versions.

contribution.concept: semantic language refinement
inner semantics
invariant language properties
These properties consequently follow from the inner semantics of a model or language

review_notes: Added semantic language refinement and inner semantics as formal constructs used to reason about language variants; checked invariant properties and their stated dependence on inner semantics. No empirical accuracy claims were invented.

problem.concept: labeled development data are typically costly and difficult to obtain

task.concept: select between candidate word pronunciations using unlabeled speech data that only potentially contain instances of the words under test

method.concept: trained classifiers representing each model to automatically generate putative labels

contribution.concept: alternative semi-supervised framework for likelihood-based model selection
minimax-optimal censored likelihood ratio tests that recover the nonparametric sign test as a limiting case
Results provide supporting evidence for the utility of this approach

review_notes: Restored semi-supervised model-selection mode and the speech-data condition that target word instances are only potentially present. Checked pseudo-labeling, robust statistics, censored likelihood ratios, limiting sign test and cautious utility claim.

problem.concept: Research on emotion attribution has tended to focus on the perception of overt expressions of at most five or six basic emotions

task.concept: provide convergent behavioral and neural evidence concerning the representations underlying these concepts

contribution.concept: patterns of activity in mentalizing regions contain information about subtle emotional distinctions conveyed through verbal descriptions of eliciting situations
space of abstract situation features that well captures the emotion discriminations subjects make behaviorally
feature space outperforms competing models in capturing the similarity space of neural patterns in these regions
data suggest that our knowledge of others' emotions is abstract and high dimensional
data suggest that brain regions selective for mental state reasoning support relatively subtle distinctions between emotion concepts
data suggest that the neural representations in these regions are not reducible to more primitive affective dimensions such as valence and arousal

review_notes: Removed patterns of brain activity from method because they are measured evidence rather than a technique. Restored data-suggest uncertainty to all three A6 findings; checked separate subtle-emotion decoding and competing-model feature-space comparisons.

problem.concept: Language carries and conveys meaning which feeds assumptions and judgments that can lead to the development of stereotypes and discrimination

contribution.concept: Twelve percent of the tweets (n = 43) were found to contain discriminatory language

Thematic analysis of the biased tweets identified 8 broad themes describing language-based age discrimination: assumptions and judgments, older people as different, uncharacteristic characteristics, old as negative, young as positive, infantilization, internalized ageism, and internalized microaggression
language of ageism is rooted in both explicit actions and implicit attitudes which make it highly complex and difficult to identify

review_notes: Checked qualitative/thematic methods, age-discrimination objective, 12-percent/n=43 discriminatory-tweet result, all eight named themes and the explicit/implicit complexity finding. Participant/tweet counts are unnamed samples, not dataset names. No correction needed.

method.concept: approaches which exploit the hierarchical structure of the question classes

contribution.concept: new approach to building a question classifier using log-linear models

review_notes: Checked the introduced log-linear question classifier, distinct syntactic/semantic feature groups and hierarchical class-structure approaches. The abstract reports evaluation without numerical success claims, and the draft correctly does not invent them.

problem.concept: Such a definition is based on an arbitrary human decision and may not best capture what a style really is

task.concept: explicitly encode the style of an artwork
explore the style space of anime portrait illustrations

contribution.concept: metric learning-based method

definition of style captures the differences between artists, as shown by classification performances, and such that the style representation can be interpreted, manipulated and visualized through style-conditioned image generation through a Generative Adversarial Network

review_notes: Added style-conditioned image generation as the explicit operational visualization/manipulation setting. Checked arbitrary-style-definition uncertainty, metric-learning method, GAN and artist-discrimination finding with its representational interpretation qualification.

problem.concept: challenge for community platform operators on efficient administration and moderation to ensure the quality of content and to prevent violations of laws (e.g. copyright, privacy, illegal content) and community rules
Since this is a time consuming task it does not scale up with Web 2.0 dimensions

task.concept: predict the behavior in an online community for different policies

method.concept: systematic variation of simulated quality assurance mechanisms

contribution.concept: CoSiMo
model plausibly captures the influence of policies to content quality and can be therefore exploited for optimization of real online communities

review_notes: Checked moderation/law-quality challenges and administrator scalability, policy-dependent behavior prediction, CoSiMo, model-based simulation and systematic variation of quality mechanisms. Retained plausibly captures rather than strengthening it to a proven real-world optimization result.
